title: Bob Burns' Hollywood Haloween
overview: Who could have known that in an unassuming and tiny backyard in Burbank, one man's  twisted vision could spread like a creative virus and infect thousands with a sense of  wonder? Back when "social media" was word of mouth and "crowd-sourcing" meant  enlisting your friends and neighbors in an inspired army of the macabre, Bob Burns and  his special effects friends --many of whom went on to win Academy Awards®, including  Rick Baker (American Werewolf in Londo11), D~nnis Muren (Star Wars) , Robert and Dennis  Skotak (Aliens, The Abyss and Terminator'2) , and Greg Nicotero (The Walking Dead)-brought  their homemade blend of Hollywood magic and vaudeville style to create many  years of ingenious Halloween storytelling ... stopping, warming and capturing the hearts  of fans and aspiring filmmakers~everywhere! This is their story ...
